title: Synthetic two-compartment IV bolus plasma PK
description: Noise-free synthetic biexponential IV bolus plasma concentrations (Dose = 10 mg, CL = 0.50 L/h, V1 = 1.0 L, Q = 1.50 L/h, V2 = 3.0 L). The 48 h sample is below the 0.05 ug/mL LLOQ and stored as BLQ. Research-use synthetic fixture only.
